title: A ride is ordered, tracked, then cancelled
user: Marco, 41. Lives at 12 Elm Street and works at 500 Market Street. Approves ride orders when asked. Decides to walk instead once the ride is on its way.

steps.content: Get me a ride to work, I'm at home.
Actually cancel the ride, it's nice out, I'll walk.

rubric: The ride was ordered with the ride tool from home (12 Elm Street) to work (500 Market Street) after the user's approval.
Progress from the ride reached the agent (a process or status in memory or the document).
The ride was cancelled with cancel_ride after the user asked, and nothing else was ordered.
